notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: [p]The NodeJS error has been removed, and the build is being temporarily reverted to give me time to properly fix the issue.[/p]

notes.title: Price Decrease + Listening to Feedback
notes.content: [p]After listening to feedback, I’ve gone ahead and lowered the price back down to $0.99 USD (and the equivalent in other countries). I’m also still listening closely to feedback, and the next major update will be out as soon as possible! Thanks for all the support and input![/p][p]— Ajwct[/p]

notes.title: So what's next?
notes.content: [p][b]New Update Announcement![/b][/p][p]First off, I’d like to thank everyone for the feedback during the free promotion, it was incredibly helpful. I’m excited to announce that a brand new update is dropping soon, and it’s packed with features based directly on your input.[/p][p]Here’s what’s coming:[/p][list][*][p] [b]Level Builder[/b] – Create and share your own custom stages[/p][/*][*][p] [b]VS Mode[/b] – A new game mode where the enemy ship finally fires back. Picture a turn-based naval combat showdown.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for all the support, stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Free Promotion + A Thank You
notes.content:
[p][b]As a thank you for all the support Caribbean Crashers has received, I'm making the game FREE to own on Steam for a limited time![/b][/p][p]Now’s the perfect time to jump in and give it a try. I truly appreciate everyone who’s supported the game so far, your feedback means a lot. If you have any suggestions, feel free to leave them below as I begin work on the next update.[/p][p]Thanks again for everything![/p][p]— Ajwct
[/p]

notes.title: Removal of EULA
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that the End User License Agreement (EULA) for [b]Caribbean Crashers[/b] has been removed! This update is in line with our commitment to keeping the game DRM-free, just like its version on [b]Itch.io[/b] and the upcoming release on [url="https://3o6.com"]3o6.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]This change ensures you can enjoy the game without any restrictions, giving you the freedom to play as you wish. Thanks for your continued support, and we look forward to seeing you on the high seas![/p]

notes.title: Price Adjustment for Caribbean Crashers
notes.content:
Dear Caribbean Crashers Community,

We would like to inform you of an upcoming change to the pricing of Caribbean Crashers across all regions. Beginning December 1st, the price of the game will be adjusted in most regions to better reflect the costs of development and ongoing support.

This change will not affect the price in the following regions:

Brazil
Kazakhstan
Russia
South Africa
Ukraine
At its current price point, we are unable to sustain the development and improvements we aim to deliver. This adjustment will enable us to continue providing updates, improvements, and support for the game while maintaining a high level of quality for our community.

We understand that pricing changes can be challenging, and we appreciate your understanding and continued support as we work to enhance Caribbean Crashers for everyone.

Thank you for being part of our community.

Sincerely,
The Bloxhill Team

notes.title: Update 2.2 Is here!
notes.content:
Caribbean Crashers - Update 2.2 Patch Notes

Ahoy, Crashers!

We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we’re excited to bring you this latest update packed with improvements based on your suggestions!

What's New:

Level Completion Check: We've added a new check after completing each level to ensure all your progress is accurately tracked and recorded. This should make your gameplay smoother and more reliable, allowing you to enjoy the journey without any hiccups.
Bug Fixes & Improvements:

Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed some pesky bugs that were causing issues in the game.
Performance Enhancements: Various optimizations have been made to improve overall game performance and stability.
Minor Tweaks: Adjustments have been made to certain gameplay elements to enhance your experience.
Brand Update:

Rebranded Patch Notes: Along with these updates, we’re excited to introduce a fresh new design for our patch notes to better align with the Bloxhill brand. We hope you enjoy the new look!
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We’re committed to making Caribbean Crashers the best experience possible. Keep the feedback coming, and we'll keep improving!

notes.title: Attention Caribbean Crashers Community!
notes.content:
We want to hear from YOU! As we continue to develop and improve Caribbean Crashers, we want your input on what should be added next. Whether it's new features, characters, storylines, or gameplay mechanics, your feedback is invaluable to us.

Please share your ideas and suggestions in the comments below or on our official forums. Your creativity and passion help us make the game better for everyone!

Thank you for being a part of the Caribbean Crashers adventure. Let's make this game amazing together!

notes.title: Language Settings
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've got some exciting news to share from the Caribbean Crashers team! 


Guess what? We're expanding our horizons and making Caribbean Crashers even more inclusive and fun for everyone! 

We're thrilled to announce that Caribbean Crashers now supports Ukrainian and Spanish languages! 🇺🇦🇪🇸 That's right, amigos and друзі, you can now enjoy the sun-soaked adventures, wild waves, and island escapades in your native language.


Whether you're shooting canons or listening to the menu music, you can now do it all in Ukrainian or Spanish. Because hey, who said paradise should have language barriers?


So, grab your sunscreen, brush up on your Ukrainian or Spanish, and get ready to dive into the ultimate pirate experience with Caribbean Crashers! See you on the ships!

notes.title: 2.0 IS OUT!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the highly anticipated 2.0 update is now live on Steam! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure with a plethora of exciting new features waiting for you. and let's just say, there are a lot of them.

Set sail starting May 10th, and experience the excitement for yourself! 

Here's some of the things you can expect to see! 

-Dynamic Physics Interaction:

Implemented dynamic physics interactions where hitting objects that support characters will cause them to fall, enhancing realism and interactivity within the game environment.

-Additional Levels:

Added several new levels to provide players with more challenges and gameplay variety. Progression system ensures players must complete previous levels to unlock subsequent ones.

And more!

If you wish to read more feel free to head over to our in depth patch notes page by going here: https://www.bloxhill.com/caribbean-crashers/v2-0

We can't wait to see you on board!
